description: Businesses listed in the portal catalogue near a fishing water or place: accommodation, restaurants, fishing tackle shops, e-shops (by region), guides and boat rental, and fish sales. Returns name, type, distance, district, starting price, opening hours text, website and page URL; phone and e-mail are only on the listing page. Texts are supplied by the business owners. Give water_id, city, or lat and lon.

city.description: Name of a Slovak district town, also in other languages, e.g. "Piešťany", "Pöstyén".

kind.description: Optional type: ubytovanie = accommodation, restauracia = restaurant, predajna = tackle shop, eshop = online shop, sluzba = guide/course/boat rental/service, ryby = fish sales.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

water_id.description: Page id of a fishing water (from search_site or waters_near); its position is used.

name: list_services
title: Accommodation, shops and services for anglers
